endpoints/ contains 12 small Node modules. In each file, change the API_VERSION
constant from "v1" to "v2". Nothing else in the files should change. When you are
done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes.

arguments.command: sed -i 's/const API_VERSION = "v1";/const API_VERSION = "v2";/' endpoints/*.js && grep -rn "API_VERSION = " endpoints/ | sort
